verdict.rationale: Alloy documents real-time decisioning on submitted events, including interdicting on transactions. When a Source Workflow is mapped, the Events response returns its results in an evaluations[] array, which covers screening a payment before release and reading back the decision. Nothing in the evidence shows the supporting matches (e.g., sanctions or watchlist hit details) that a compliance officer would inspect behind the decision. Missing for 10: documented match or hit details supporting the decision, explicit pre-release payment hold/release flow, a reviewer UI for inspecting decision rationale, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: Alloy supports dozens of use cases like interdicting on transactions
build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens
